description:
The Advanced Freediver course is designed to fulfill that personal need to refine and improve your freediving skills, allowing you to progress slowly while learning how your body performs during apnea. 

The PADI Advanced Freediver teaches you the concept of efficiency when freediving, making your body stronger and more effective in the water. Discover the exciting freefall and Frenzel techniques, refined buddy system skills, and more.

Students will learn to further develop their static apnea over 2 minutes and 30 seconds, dynamic apnea to 50 meters/165' feet, and free immersion and constant weight freediving beyond 20 meters/60 feet.

itinerary:
**Prior to Course**
Complete the required independent study of PADI Advanced Freediver e-Learning from the comfort of your home.

- Friday - Classroom 12 p.m. - 6 p.m.
- Saturday - Pool 8 a.m. - 4 p.m.
- Sunday - Ocean 7 a.m. - 1:30 p.m.
highlights:
The Advanced Freediver course consists of three main phases

- Classroom/Knowledge development about advanced freediving techniques and equipment. You’ll study independently using the Freediver online materials as well as an Instructor-led class session.

- Pool/Confined water training to learn stretching and relaxation techniques as well as refine static and dynamic apnea.

- Goal – static apnea of 2 minutes, 30 seconds (2 minutes for freedivers younger than 18) and dynamic apnea of 50m/165ft (40 m/130ft for freedivers younger than 18).

- Open water sessions – 2 Open Water dive sessions to practice deeper free immersion and constant weight freedives, along with additional buddy procedures and rescue techniques. 

- Goal – constant weight Freedive of 20m/66 ft, maximum 24m/80ft (15m/50ft for freedivers younger than 18)
highlight_description: Our PADI Advanced Freediver course is for freedivers who want to explore their growing interest in freediving and extend their personal best depths and freediving skills in a safe and comfortable way.
what_to_bring:
- Towel, Swimsuit, swim shorts, sunscreen, water or favorite hydration drinks, and snacks.

- Pool Training Wetsuit - a 3 or 4/3 mm surf suit/triathlon swimsuit or similar is recommended for pool training. Please let us know if you cannot provide your own pool wetsuit.

- We do not require you to supply or own your own freediving gear for this course, but owning your own personal set of freediving equipment will surely make your diving experience more comfortable. (see recommended equipment list below).

- Wetsuit - 5mm 2-piece Freediving wetsuit or a 7mm during the winter season.

- Weight Belt with 6 to 14lb of weights, a rubber weight belt with “Marseille buckle” style is highly recommended. By now, you should know how much weight you will need with your wetsuit in saltwater.

- Mask – A small-volume silicone freediving mask, mask defog.

- Safety Lanyard 

- Snorkel - the simpler the better, no dry-snorkel from Scuba.
 
- Fins – Long-blade Freediving fins, any material that you are currently comfortable with will work.

- Gloves – 3 or 5mm are recommended, depending on the time of the year and your tolerance to cold.

- Equipment bag or gear crate – Something to carry all your freediving gear from the car to the dive site.
special_requirements:
**Prerequisites**

- Be at least 15 years of age (with parental consent) or older
- You need to be in good physical health. NO prior experience with scuba diving, snorkeling, or freediving is required.
- Paperwork: Complete the PADI Medical Questionnaire, Freediver Liability Release, and the Statement of Understanding.
faqs:
**What is the PADI Advanced Freediver Course with Dive California?**

The PADI Advanced Freediver course is the first level of freediving and includes an instructor-led classroom session, confined water (or pool), and 2 Open Water sessions in the ocean.

The PADI Advanced Freediver course also includes an e-certification that will allow you to freedive with a buddy in a pool or in the ocean.

**What is included in the PADI Advanced Freediver course with Dive California?**

- All necessary freediving gear
- PADI Advanced Freediver e-Learning study materials
- PADI e-certification
- Instructor-led classroom session
- Confined Water/pool session
- 2 Open Water sessions

**How long does the PADI Advanced Freediver Course take?**

Our PADI Advanced Freediver course will take a minimum of 3 days, allowing you to take the course at a relaxed pace.

**What is the minimum age for the PADI Advanced Freediver Course with Dive California?**

Minimum age for the PADI Advanced Freediver course is 15 years of age, in good health, and have adequate swimming skills.

**What should I bring?**

- Towel, Swimsuit, swim shorts, sunscreen, water or favorite hydration drinks, and snacks.

- Pool Training Wetsuit - a 3 or 4/3 mm surf suit/triathlon swimsuit or similar is recommended for pool training. Please let us know if you cannot provide your own pool wetsuit.

**Will I receive a certification?**

You will earn a certification recognition after successfully completing this program.
